mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 0.2 percentage points over the past three months signals labor market deterioration, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL and UNRATE above their 3-month moving averages signals stagflation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL and UNRATE both above 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL and UNRATE are both above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong growth in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings continue to rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth exceeds 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.5 million units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1.5 million, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising rapidly (annual change > 2%) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is not rising (change <= 0% in one month), it signals that the Fed is not tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, which may lead to higher real interest rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annual change > 2% and FEDFUNDS change <= 0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual change > 2% and FEDFUNDS change <= 0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a robust economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings growth continues.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 2%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
